tooling: NAT KVM with 20 forwarded ports, root over SSH on a non-standard port, IPv6 /64 or /80, no individual support - all questions go to the community thread.
chaining: Twenty forwarded IPv4 ports plus a dedicated IPv6 subnet is real inbound reachability for 20 services, which the BoxyBSD box does not give without buying an address or using a shared load balancer.
